source: Bundled anchor elevations for AUDIT.3 Phase 3 verification. Each (lat, lon) is the centroid of a well-known US city; `expected_m` is the city's elevation from public sources (USGS GNIS, NOAA, municipal references), cross-checked against the USGS EPQS endpoint at https://epqs.nationalmap.gov/v1/json on 2026-05-24.
notes: Cities chosen to span the FL/TX/LA/NC book footprint plus a high-elevation outlier (Denver) so the test catches both no-data and out-of-range failures. Tolerance is per-point because EPQS returns the nearest-pixel value at 1/3-arcsec which can differ from a city centroid by a few meters for a hilly city. Use `python -m scripts.extract_elevations --verify` to recheck.
